Name:
5th album reports
(Has it Leaked & fake Columbia documents)
Notes: In 2020, a series of rumors surrounding a fifth album began circulating. In addition to the insistence of Swedish outlet "Has It Leaked", a supposed document was leaked that anticipated a May 26 release. Rumors of a fifth album disappeared after Epilogue. Has It Leaked continues to insist to this day that a fifth album was in late stages of development in 2020.

Name: Wolfgang Flür ft. Thomas Bangalter
Notes: In 2024, it was revealed that Thomas Bangalter worked in "Times", the new album by former Kraftwerk member. The two songs he collaborated on ("Über All" and "Monday To The Moon") were credited to a certain "Thomas Vangarde". A few weeks after the release, it was confirmed by sources within Daft Punk's social media team that Flür had been working all this time with a Facebook user claiming to be Thomas. Flür himself confirmed his experience through an interview.
